operating_notes.text: April 2026 net turnover was ₹500.85 Cr, up 18.09% YoY, with 2&3 wheelers up 36% by value and exports down 35% by value.
FY26 volume growth: alloy wheels +19%, tractor wheels +23%, truck wheels +11% YoY.
FY26 capex was ₹192.81 Cr, down 9.2% from ₹212.35 Cr in FY25; capital work-in-progress was ₹154.48 Cr at March 2026.
May 2026 net turnover ₹485.98 Cr, up 18.43% YoY; value growth 18% against volume growth 4%, with aluminum wheels up 30% by value.
May 2026 segment value growth: 2 & 3 wheelers +50%, aluminum +30%, tractor +21%, truck +9%, passenger car -10%, exports -21%.
FY26 alloy wheel capacity expanded to 5 million units and aluminium knuckles to 5 lakh units p.a.
FY26 EBITDA per wheel was ₹262, flat YoY; Q4FY26 was ₹282.
FY26 exports were ₹454 Cr, down 19% YoY; FY27 guidance is about ₹600 Cr.
End-user mix FY26: passenger cars and MUV 54%, commercial vehicles 28%, tractor 13%, 2-3 wheelers 2%, OTR 1%, knuckles 1%.
Q2FY27 revenue includes supplementary sales of ~₹140 crores from raw material pricing revisions.

timeline.summary: Dheeraj Garg, R.K. Garg, Sunena Garg, Priva Garg, and 19 promoter group entities declared no share encumbrance under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26, filed April 4, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,474.63 Cr (+19.5% YoY), net profit ₹60.85 Cr (+0.3% YoY).
Steel Strips Wheels reported May 2026 net turnover of ₹485.98 Cr; driven by strong 2&3 wheeler and tractor demand.
Steel Strips Wheels released its Q4FY26 investor presentation detailing record FY26 revenue of ₹5,183 Cr and volume milestones.
Steel Strips Wheels Ltd. shared the audio recording of its 'Q4FY26 Earnings Conference Call' with analysts/institutional investors on June 2, 2025, via its website.
Steel Strips Wheels announced the resignation of Deputy Managing Director Mohan Joshi effective June 3, 2026.
Steel Strips Wheels' Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 PAT growth of 15-20%, EBITDA per wheel of ₹300 and exports of ₹600 Cr, with ₹500 Cr Bhuj capex trials from October.
Steel Strips Wheels Limited Board of Directors declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 1.50 per equity share effective 23 October 2026.
Steel Strips Wheels reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,930 Cr up 61% YoY and approved a ₹1,400 Cr greenfield plant in Maharashtra.
Steel Strips Wheels Limited made the audio recording of the Analysts/Institutional Investors conference call available on its website on 26 October 2026.
